#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Print each distinct non-blank stdin line once, in first-seen order, as '<line> x<count>'."""
import sys


def main():
    counts = {}
    for raw in sys.stdin:
        line = raw.rstrip("\r\n")
        if not line.strip():
            continue
        counts[line] = counts.get(line, 0) + 1
    for line, n in counts.items():
        print(f"{line} x{n}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
EOF
